<!doctype html>
<html lang="ru" data-heist-echo-release="4.0.0">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="osgard-game-version" content="4.0.0-operations-frontier">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#070b10">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#070b11">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
  <meta name="application-name" content="HEIST//ECHO">
  <meta name="description" content="HEIST//ECHO 4.0.0 — автономная тактическая песочница с четырьмя картами, редактором уровней, детерминированным повтором операций и ORACLE-анализом.">
  <title>HEIST//ECHO 4.0.0 — Operations Frontier</title>
  <style>
:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --bg: #080d13;
  --panel: rgba(15, 23, 32, .88);
  --panel-2: #111b25;
  --line: rgba(168, 197, 221, .13);
  --line-strong: rgba(168, 197, 221, .24);
  --text: #edf4fa;
  --muted: #8295a8;
  --dim: #516475;
  --cyan: #66e6e0;
  --cyan-2: #31bfbf;
  --amber: #e4ae61;
  --red: #ff6f79;
  --green: #88e5b6;
  --mono: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;
  --sans: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { background: var(--bg); min-height: 100%; }
body { margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: hidden; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% -10%, rgba(39, 104, 117, .12), transparent 46%), linear-gradient(180deg, #0a1118 0%, var(--bg) 70%); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; }
button { color: inherit; font: inherit; }
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }
.ambient { position: fixed; pointer-events: none; width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: .08; z-index: -1; }
.ambient-a { top: 220px; left: -330px; background: #2ab9d7; }
.ambient-b { top: 560px; right: -350px; background: #c4863a; }
.topbar { min-height: 74px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 max(28px, calc((100vw - 1440px)/2)); position: relative; z-index: 1; background: rgba(7, 12, 18, .72); }
.brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--text); }
.brand-mark { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 6px); gap: 3px; transform: rotate(45deg); }
.brand-mark i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--cyan); display: block; }
.brand-mark i:nth-child(2), .brand-mark i:nth-child(3) { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 11px rgba(102, 230, 224, .34); }
.brand-word { letter-spacing: .13em; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; }
.brand-word span, .footer-brand span { color: var(--cyan); padding: 0 2px; }
.top-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 25px; }
.eyebrow, .field-label, .kicker, .stamp-label, .stamp-small, .map-chip, .build-tag, .tiny-status, .queue-count, .event-count, .execution-state, .execution-footer, .footer-brand small, .agent-info small, .agent-select-mark, .queue-list-header, .canvas-corner { font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .09em; }
.eyebrow { color: #64798a; font-size: 10px; }
.build-tag { font-size: 10px; color: #b6c8d6; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 3px; }
.live-dot, .tiny-status i, .footer-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(102,230,224,.6); }
.shell { width: min(1440px, calc(100% - 56px)); margin: 0 auto; }
.intro { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 30px; padding: 47px 0 30px; }
.kicker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--cyan); font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 13px; }
.kicker-line { display: block; width: 25px; height: 1px; background: var(--cyan); }
h1 { font-size: clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 58px); line-height: 1.09; letter-spacing: -.055em; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; }
h1 em { color: var(--cyan); font-style: normal; font-weight: 500; }
.intro-text { margin: 15px 0 0; color: #93a6b8; max-width: 620px; line-height: 1.75; font-size: 13px; }
.mission-stamp { min-width: 222px; margin-bottom: 4px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line-strong); padding: 4px 0 5px 19px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.stamp-label { color: #617487; font-size: 9px; }
.mission-stamp strong { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .12em; font-weight: 700; }
.stamp-divider { background: var(--line-strong); height: 1px; width: 100%; }
.stamp-small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }
.mission-strip { min-height: 76px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(20, 32, 43, .94), rgba(12, 20, 28, .86)); display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 14px 18px; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.mission-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; flex: 0 0 245px; }
.mission-index { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 22px; color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.06em; }
.mission-title div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.field-label { font-size: 9px; color: #6f8496; display: block; line-height: 1.4; }
.mission-title strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
.mission-strip > p { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #8fa1b2; line-height: 1.6; flex: 1; max-width: 720px; }
.tick-box { flex: 0 0 82px; padding-left: 19px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line-strong); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.tick-box strong { font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; }
.workspace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.62fr) minmax(350px, .95fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; }
.left-column, .right-column { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; min-width: 0; }
.panel { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: linear-gradient(144deg, rgba(17, 27, 37, .96), rgba(11, 18, 26, .97)); box-shadow: 0 14px 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12); }
.panel-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.board-heading { padding: 19px 21px 16px; }
.panel-heading h2, .execution-top h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.035em; font-weight: 700; }
.board-meta { display: flex; gap: 7px; align-items: center; }
.map-chip { font-size: 9px; color: #a6b9c9; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }
.map-chip.muted { color: #637789; border-color: var(--line); }
.map-chip-dot { display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: var(--cyan); border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 5px; vertical-align: 1px; }
.canvas-frame { position: relative; margin: 0 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(104, 139, 163, .16); background: #0a131b; overflow: hidden; }
#game-board { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; touch-action: manipulation; cursor: crosshair; }
.canvas-corner { position: absolute; font-size: 8px; color: rgba(168, 194, 210, .62); pointer-events: none; background: rgba(8, 14, 20, .8); padding: 5px 7px; }
.corner-tl { top: 8px; left: 8px; }
.corner-br { bottom: 8px; right: 8px; }
.legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 20px 12px; color: #8296a8; font-size: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.legend span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.legend-dot { height: 8px; width: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }
.legend-dot.operative { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(102,230,224,.4); }
.legend-diamond { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--red); display: inline-block; transform: rotate(45deg); }
.legend-box { width: 9px; height: 9px; display: inline-block; border: 1px solid; }
.legend-box.camera { border-color: var(--amber); background: rgba(228,174,97,.4); }
.legend-box.data { border-color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(102,230,224,.4); }
.legend-zone { height: 8px; width: 12px; display: inline-block; background: rgba(228,174,97,.19); border: 1px solid rgba(228,174,97,.55); }
.map-instruction { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 20px 15px; color: #8399ab; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
.instruction-icon { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 16px; }
.activity-panel { padding-bottom: 7px; }
.compact-heading { padding: 17px 19px 13px; }
.event-count { color: #5e7487; font-size: 9px; white-space: nowrap; }
.event-log { padding: 0 18px 7px; max-height: 178px; overflow: auto; }
.log-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 9px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(168, 197, 221, .07); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; }
.log-tick { color: #5e788b; font-family: var(--mono); }
.log-message { color: #98aaba; }
.log-entry.success .log-message { color: var(--green); }
.log-entry.danger .log-message { color: var(--red); }
.log-entry.warning .log-message { color: var(--amber); }
.log-entry.move .log-message { color: #8da4b6; }
.log-entry.system .log-message { color: #8bdedb; }
.crew-panel { padding-bottom: 14px; }
.tiny-status { color: #7d91a1; font-size: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.agent-selectors { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 9px; padding: 0 13px; }
.agent-card { background: rgba(5, 12, 18, .42); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 2px; padding: 11px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; min-width: 0; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s; position: relative; }
.agent-card:hover { border-color: rgba(102, 230, 224, .4); }
.agent-card.selected { background: rgba(39, 118, 124, .13); border-color: rgba(102, 230, 224, .65); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(102, 230, 224, .06); }
.agent-avatar { width: 34px; height: 38px; flex: 0 0 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.4); clip-path: polygon(10% 0, 90% 0, 100% 18%, 100% 82%, 82% 100%, 0 100%, 0 18%); color: var(--cyan); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; background: linear-gradient(130deg, rgba(102,230,224,.15), rgba(16,37,46,.2)); position: relative; }
.agent-avatar i { position: absolute; bottom: 4px; left: 50%; width: 4px; height: 2px; background: var(--cyan); transform: translateX(-50%); }
.kite-avatar { color: #c2b7ff; border-color: rgba(164,149,255,.45); background: linear-gradient(130deg, rgba(164,149,255,.15), rgba(29,27,49,.2)); }
.kite-avatar i { background: #c2b7ff; }
.agent-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.agent-info strong { font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .08em; font-size: 11px; }
.agent-info small { color: #6f8798; font-size: 8px; white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.agent-info em { color: #93a5b5; font-style: normal; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.25; }
.agent-select-mark { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 7px; font-size: 8px; color: #526b7d; }
.agent-card.selected .agent-select-mark { color: var(--cyan); }
.selected-note { margin: 12px 14px 0; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.1); background: rgba(40,121,126,.06); }
.note-mark { font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--cyan); font-size: 12px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.25); padding-right: 10px; }
.selected-note > span:last-child { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.selected-note strong { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; }
.selected-note small { color: #8197a9; font-size: 10px; }
.tools-panel { padding-bottom: 13px; }
.queue-count { font-size: 9px; color: var(--cyan); white-space: nowrap; }
.subcopy { color: #7b8fa0; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.55; margin: -2px 19px 13px; }
.action-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px; padding: 0 13px; }
.action-button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; text-align: left; padding: 10px 11px; min-height: 52px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(7, 14, 20, .54); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; }
.action-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--line-strong); background: rgba(21, 36, 47, .8); }
.action-button:disabled { opacity: .34; cursor: not-allowed; }
.action-symbol { width: 29px; height: 29px; flex: 0 0 29px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(102,230,224,.08); color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.17); font-size: 17px; }
.secure-action .action-symbol { color: var(--amber); background: rgba(228,174,97,.08); border-color: rgba(228,174,97,.2); }
.action-button > span:nth-child(2) { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.action-button strong { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }
.action-button small { font-size: 9px; color: #72889a; }
.action-button b { align-self: flex-start; font-family: var(--mono); color: #536a7c; border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 400; padding: 3px 5px; }
.queue-list-wrap { margin: 15px 16px 0; max-height: 235px; overflow: auto; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.queue-list-header { font-size: 8px; color: #7590a3; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 11px 2px 7px; }
.queue-list-header span:last-child { color: var(--cyan); }
.kite-list-header { border-top: 1px solid rgba(168,197,221,.07); margin-top: 7px; }
.queue-list { padding: 0 0 3px; margin: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.queue-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 25px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 26px; background: rgba(5,11,16,.45); padding: 5px 7px; font-size: 9px; color: #a5b5c2; border-left: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.24); }
.queue-list.kite-list li { border-left-color: rgba(164,149,255,.32); }
.queue-list .step-number { color: #587084; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; }
.queue-list .step-kind { font-family: var(--mono); color: #8be0db; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.queue-list.kite-list .step-kind { color: #c4baff; }
.queue-list .step-detail { color: #61788b; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 8px; white-space: nowrap; }
.queue-list.empty li { display: block; color: #617789; font-style: italic; background: transparent; border-left-color: transparent; padding: 5px 2px 8px; }
.utility-actions { display: flex; gap: 7px; margin: 12px 13px 0; }
.quiet-button { color: #8fa2b3; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); cursor: pointer; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 10px; transition: color .15s, border-color .15s, background .15s; }
.quiet-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgba(102,230,224,.45); color: var(--text); background: rgba(102,230,224,.04); }
.quiet-button:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }
.danger-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgba(255,111,121,.4); color: var(--red); }
.utility-actions .quiet-button { flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
.execution-panel { padding: 18px 18px 12px; }
.execution-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.execution-state { font-size: 8px; color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.23); padding: 6px 7px; white-space: nowrap; }
.execution-state.danger { color: var(--red); border-color: rgba(255,111,121,.25); }
.execution-state.success { color: var(--green); border-color: rgba(136,229,182,.26); }
.status-message { min-height: 37px; margin: 12px 0 14px; color: #91a3b2; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.7; }
.primary-button { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 47px; background: linear-gradient(95deg, #69e5df, #3ec8c7); color: #062126; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 13px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .01em; box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(49,191,191,.1); transition: filter .15s, transform .15s; }
.primary-button:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
.primary-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.run-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(6,33,38,.3); font-size: 10px; }
.button-arrow { margin-left: auto; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }
.sim-controls { display: flex; gap: 7px; margin-top: 8px; }
.sim-controls .quiet-button { flex: 1; }
.sim-controls[hidden], [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.execution-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 11px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: #53697b; font-size: 8px; }
.execution-footer span:first-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.footer-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; }
.protocol-panel { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.12); background: rgba(22, 65, 70, .09); }
.protocol-icon { font-family: Georgia, serif; color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.24); border-radius: 50%; width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-style: italic; font-size: 12px; }
.protocol-panel p { margin: 0; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.65; color: #8195a5; }
.protocol-panel strong { color: #b8d4d9; font-weight: 700; }
.footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 22px; padding: 23px 0 30px; margin-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.footer-brand { font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .09em; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10px; }
.footer-brand small { color: #597084; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .02em; font-size: 8px; margin-left: 8px; }
.footer > p { color: #617789; font-size: 9px; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; }
.footer-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.footer-actions button { background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 5px; color: #8197a9; font-size: 9px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.footer-actions button:hover { color: var(--cyan); }
.footer-actions #edit-button { color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.22); padding: 8px 10px; }
.toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 24px; transform: translate(-50%, 18px); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; padding: 12px 16px; max-width: min(520px, calc(100vw - 30px)); background: #12242a; border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.25); box-shadow: 0 12px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color: #dce9ee; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s; z-index: 10; }
.toast.visible { transform: translate(-50%, 0); opacity: 1; }
.toast.error { border-color: rgba(255,111,121,.4); background: #25171c; }

@media (min-width: 1150px) {
  .action-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(360px, .9fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(330px, .9fr); gap: 13px; }
  .shell { width: calc(100% - 36px); }
  .left-column, .right-column { gap: 13px; }
  .agent-selectors { gap: 6px; padding: 0 9px; }
  .agent-card { padding: 9px 7px; gap: 7px; }
  .agent-avatar { width: 30px; height: 34px; flex-basis: 30px; }
  .agent-info small { font-size: 7px; }
  .utility-actions { margin-left: 9px; margin-right: 9px; }
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .topbar { padding: 0 20px; min-height: 65px; }
  .eyebrow { display: none; }
  .shell { width: calc(100% - 32px); }
  .intro { padding-top: 36px; align-items: flex-start; }
  .mission-stamp { min-width: 190px; }
  .mission-strip { gap: 12px; padding: 13px; }
  .mission-title { flex-basis: 210px; }
  .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .right-column { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; }
  .crew-panel, .tools-panel { grid-column: auto; }
  .execution-panel, .protocol-panel { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .footer { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .footer > p { order: 3; flex-basis: 100%; text-align: left; }
}
@media (max-width: 580px) {
  .topbar { padding: 0 14px; min-height: 60px; }
  .brand-word { font-size: 13px; }
  .brand { gap: 10px; }
  .top-meta { gap: 0; }
  .build-tag { font-size: 8px; padding: 7px; }
  .shell { width: calc(100% - 24px); }
  .intro { padding: 29px 0 20px; display: block; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(32px, 10vw, 45px); }
  .intro-text { font-size: 11px; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 12px; }
  .mission-stamp { margin-top: 21px; min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 12px; row-gap: 6px; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 12px 0 0; }
  .stamp-label { grid-column: 1; }
  .mission-stamp strong { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 1; font-size: 10px; }
  .stamp-divider { display: none; }
  .stamp-small { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .mission-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .mission-title { flex: initial; grid-column: 1; }
  .mission-strip > p { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; font-size: 10px; padding-top: 9px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .tick-box { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; border-left: 1px solid var(--line-strong); padding-left: 13px; }
  .tick-box strong { font-size: 14px; }
  .workspace { gap: 12px; }
  .left-column, .right-column { gap: 12px; }
  .board-heading { padding: 15px 13px 12px; }
  .panel-heading h2, .execution-top h2 { font-size: 15px; }
  .map-chip { font-size: 7px; padding: 5px 5px; }
  .canvas-frame { margin: 0 8px; }
  .canvas-corner { font-size: 6px; padding: 4px; }
  .legend { padding: 11px 12px; gap: 9px 12px; font-size: 8px; }
  .map-instruction { padding: 10px 13px 12px; font-size: 9px; }
  .right-column { display: flex; }
  .crew-panel, .tools-panel, .execution-panel { width: 100%; }
  .agent-selectors { padding: 0 10px; gap: 8px; }
  .agent-card { padding: 11px 9px; gap: 8px; }
  .agent-avatar { width: 33px; height: 37px; flex-basis: 33px; }
  .agent-info small { font-size: 8px; }
  .agent-info em { font-size: 8px; }
  .compact-heading { padding: 14px 14px 12px; }
  .subcopy { margin-left: 14px; margin-right: 14px; }
  .action-grid { padding: 0 10px; }
  .queue-list-wrap { margin-left: 12px; margin-right: 12px; }
  .utility-actions { margin-left: 10px; margin-right: 10px; }
  .quiet-button { padding: 9px 7px; font-size: 9px; }
  .execution-panel { padding: 15px 13px 11px; }
  .footer { gap: 10px; padding-top: 17px; }
  .footer-brand { flex: 1; }
  .footer-brand small { display: block; margin: 5px 0 0; }
  .footer-actions { gap: 7px; }
  .footer > p { font-size: 8px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
}

/* First-session orientation: always visible, compact, and non-blocking. */
.first-run-guide {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 1.15fr) repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(12, 24, 33, .96), rgba(11, 18, 26, .82));
}
.guide-heading, .guide-step { min-width: 0; padding: 13px 15px; }
.guide-heading { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
.guide-heading strong { max-width: 240px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; }
.guide-step { display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: flex-start; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
.guide-step:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.guide-step > span { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--cyan); font: 500 11px var(--mono); padding-top: 1px; }
.guide-step p { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }
.guide-step strong { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; }
.guide-step small { color: #8295a8; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.55; }
.footer-actions button:disabled { opacity: .42; cursor: not-allowed; }
.footer-actions #export-test-button { color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.18); padding: 8px 10px; }
.research-tools { margin: -12px 0 30px auto; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; color: #6e8496; font-size: 10px; }
.research-tools summary { cursor: pointer; text-align: right; padding: 7px 0; }
.research-tools summary:hover { color: var(--cyan); }
.research-tools-body { max-width: 430px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); padding: 13px; }
.research-tools-body p { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #8295a8; line-height: 1.55; }
.research-tools-body button { background: rgba(102,230,224,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.24); padding: 9px 11px; color: var(--cyan); cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; }
.research-tools-body button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .first-run-guide { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .guide-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 10px; }
  .guide-heading strong { max-width: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 580px) {
  .first-run-guide { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .guide-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 12px; }
  .guide-step { padding: 11px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .guide-step:nth-child(3) { border-right: 0; }
  .guide-step:nth-child(4), .guide-step:nth-child(5) { border-bottom: 0; }
  .guide-step strong { font-size: 10px; }
  .guide-step small { font-size: 9px; }
  .research-tools { margin-top: -5px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .footer-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .footer-actions button { white-space: normal; text-align: left; }
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   HEIST//ECHO · VISUAL SYSTEM 0.3
   Premium tactical command interface: better hierarchy, richer surfaces,
   readable controls and deliberate responsive behavior.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
:root {
  --bg: #070b11;
  --panel: rgba(13, 21, 30, .94);
  --panel-2: #111d29;
  --line: rgba(151, 184, 207, .16);
  --line-strong: rgba(151, 184, 207, .29);
  --text: #f1f7fc;
  --muted: #9aafc0;
  --dim: #6d8497;
  --cyan: #76f0e7;
  --cyan-2: #39c9c5;
  --amber: #efbd72;
  --red: #ff7f8e;
  --green: #8fe8bd;
  --violet: #b8aaff;
}
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; background: #070b11; }
body {
  font-size: 14px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -26%, rgba(32, 108, 126, .23), transparent 58%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 38%, rgba(142, 91, 42, .075), transparent 36%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #09111a 0%, #070b11 56%, #080d13 100%);
}
body::before {
  content: ""; position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: -1;
  background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(128, 164, 187, .022) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(128, 164, 187, .018) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 64px 64px;
  mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,.8), transparent 75%);
}
::selection { background: rgba(118, 240, 231, .25); color: #fff; }
button { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
.ambient { width: 620px; height: 620px; filter: blur(130px); opacity: .12; }
.ambient-a { top: 110px; left: -400px; background: #168ea0; }
.ambient-b { top: 600px; right: -430px; background: #986c37; opacity: .07; }
.topbar {
  min-height: 78px; padding-left: max(28px, calc((100vw - 1510px)/2)); padding-right: max(28px, calc((100vw - 1510px)/2));
  border-bottom-color: rgba(166, 200, 223, .13);
  background: rgba(6, 11, 17, .82); backdrop-filter: blur(22px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.018), 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}
.brand { gap: 15px; }
.brand-mark { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 7px); gap: 3px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(118,240,231,.14)); }
.brand-mark i { width: 7px; height: 7px; }
.brand-word { font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: .15em; }
.eyebrow { color: #8196a8; letter-spacing: .16em; }
.build-tag { border-radius: 5px; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.23); background: rgba(118,240,231,.045); padding: 9px 12px; color: #c8dbe7; }
.live-dot, .tiny-status i, .footer-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
.shell { width: min(1510px, calc(100% - 64px)); }
.intro { padding: 54px 0 30px; gap: 42px; }
.kicker { letter-spacing: .17em; font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 17px; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(42px, 4.8vw, 68px); line-height: 1.045; letter-spacing: -.06em; text-shadow: 0 3px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
h1 em { color: var(--cyan); text-shadow: 0 0 34px rgba(118,240,231,.11); }
.intro-text { color: #a4b6c4; max-width: 660px; line-height: 1.8; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 18px; }
.mission-stamp {
  min-width: 245px; padding: 12px 0 13px 21px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.42);
  position: relative; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(118,240,231,.035), transparent 90%);
}
.mission-stamp::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: 0; width: 2px; height: 28px; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(118,240,231,.38); }
.stamp-label { color: #7890a2; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .16em; }
.mission-stamp strong { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .13em; }
.stamp-divider { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(118,240,231,.25), var(--line)); }
.stamp-small { color: #8da3b4; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .13em; }
.mission-strip {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 84px; gap: 26px; padding: 16px 21px; margin-bottom: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(147,183,207,.19); border-radius: 9px;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(19,34,46,.96), rgba(11,19,28,.97) 60%, rgba(15,24,33,.92));
  box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.14), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025);
}
.mission-strip::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 35%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(118,240,231,.45)); }
.mission-title { flex-basis: 260px; }
.mission-index { font-size: 27px; color: var(--cyan); }
.field-label { color: #8197a9; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .15em; }
.mission-title strong { font-size: 14px; }
.mission-strip > p { font-size: 12px; color: #a0b3c2; line-height: 1.7; }
.tick-box { flex-basis: 90px; padding-left: 20px; }
.tick-box strong { color: var(--cyan); font-size: 18px; text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(118,240,231,.16); }
.workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.58fr) minmax(370px, .92fr); gap: 20px; }
.left-column, .right-column { gap: 20px; }
.panel {
  position: relative; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.17); border-radius: 10px;
  background: linear-gradient(142deg, rgba(17,29,41,.97), rgba(9,16,24,.985) 76%);
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.024);
}
.panel::before { content: ""; position: absolute; pointer-events: none; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(118,240,231,.24), rgba(147,183,207,.08) 45%, transparent); z-index: 1; }
.panel-heading h2, .execution-top h2 { font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: -.045em; }
.board-heading { padding: 22px 23px 18px; }
.map-chip { border-radius: 4px; font-size: 9px; padding: 7px 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.018); color: #c1d1de; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.22); }
.map-chip.muted { color: #7f94a7; }
.map-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(118,240,231,.6); }
.canvas-frame {
  margin: 0 17px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,160,187,.22); background: #08121b;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.22), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025);
}
.canvas-frame::after { content: ""; pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(1,6,10,.24), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035); }
#game-board { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; touch-action: manipulation; cursor: crosshair; }
#game-board:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: -3px; }
.canvas-corner { font-size: 8px; color: #b0c3d1; letter-spacing: .15em; border: 1px solid rgba(147,183,207,.17); background: rgba(5,11,17,.82); backdrop-filter: blur(7px); border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 8px; }
.legend { gap: 17px 18px; padding: 15px 22px 14px; color: #a1b4c3; font-size: 11px; border-bottom-color: rgba(151,184,207,.13); }
.legend span { gap: 8px; }
.legend-dot { height: 8px; width: 8px; }
.legend-zone { width: 13px; height: 9px; }
.map-instruction { padding: 13px 22px 16px; color: #a1b4c3; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.instruction-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 23px; height: 23px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.2); border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(118,240,231,.05); color: var(--cyan); }
.compact-heading { padding: 19px 21px 15px; }
.event-count { color: #90a5b6; font-size: 9px; }
.event-log { padding: 0 21px 12px; max-height: 220px; }
.log-entry { grid-template-columns: 54px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 12px; padding: 11px 0; border-top-color: rgba(151,184,207,.09); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; }
.log-tick { color: #7f98ac; }
.log-message { color: #b2c2ce; }
.log-entry.success .log-message { color: var(--green); }
.log-entry.danger .log-message { color: #ff909b; }
.log-entry.warning .log-message { color: var(--amber); }
.log-entry.system .log-message { color: var(--cyan); }
.crew-panel { padding-bottom: 17px; }
.tiny-status { color: #9aafbe; font-size: 8px; }
.agent-selectors { gap: 10px; padding: 0 16px; }
.agent-card {
  min-height: 86px; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 12px; border-radius: 7px; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.17);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(7,14,21,.8), rgba(8,14,21,.42));
  transition: border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.agent-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.45); background: rgba(118,240,231,.04); }
.agent-card:active { transform: translateY(0); }
.agent-card.selected { background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(42,132,134,.18), rgba(15,39,46,.42)); border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.72); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(118,240,231,.09), 0 8px 23px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.agent-avatar { width: 39px; height: 44px; flex-basis: 39px; border-radius: 7px; clip-path: polygon(11% 0,89% 0,100% 15%,100% 85%,85% 100%,0 100%,0 15%); font-size: 17px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
.agent-info { gap: 5px; }
.agent-info strong { font-size: 12px; }
.agent-info small { font-size: 9px; color: #95aabc; }
.agent-info em { font-size: 10px; color: #adbfcc; line-height: 1.35; }
.agent-select-mark { top: 8px; right: 9px; font-size: 9px; }
.selected-note { margin: 13px 16px 0; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.14); border-radius: 5px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(118,240,231,.055), rgba(118,240,231,.015)); padding: 11px 13px; gap: 12px; }
.note-mark { min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-right: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(118,240,231,.09); color: var(--cyan); font: 700 11px var(--mono); }
.selected-note strong { font-size: 11px; }
.selected-note small { color: #a0b3c2; font-size: 10px; }
.subcopy { color: #a0b2c1; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; margin: -2px 20px 16px; }
.action-grid { padding: 0 16px; gap: 9px; }
.action-button {
  min-height: 61px; border-radius: 7px; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.17); padding: 10px 12px; gap: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgba(5,12,18,.78), rgba(11,19,27,.68));
  transition: border-color .18s, background .18s, transform .18s, box-shadow .18s;
}
.action-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.44); background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgba(21,49,56,.7), rgba(11,24,32,.84)); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.action-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); }
.action-button:disabled { opacity: .48; filter: saturate(.65); }
.action-symbol { width: 31px; height: 31px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 16px; }
.action-button strong { font-size: 12px; }
.action-button small { font-size: 10px; color: #9db0bf; }
.action-button b { min-width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; color: #a8bbc9; background: rgba(255,255,255,.035); border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.16); }
.queue-list-wrap { margin: 16px 16px 0; }
.queue-list-header { padding: 11px 0 8px; font-size: 9px; color: #93a9ba; border-top-color: rgba(151,184,207,.14); }
.queue-list { gap: 4px; }
.queue-list li { min-height: 30px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,.014); color: #b8c7d2; font-size: 10px; }
.queue-list.empty li { color: #8298aa; background: transparent; }
.step-number { color: #89a0b2; }
.step-kind { color: #d0dce5; }
.step-detail { color: #93a8b8; }
.utility-actions { margin: 14px 16px 0; gap: 8px; }
.quiet-button { min-height: 36px; border-radius: 5px; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.18); background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); color: #b9c9d5; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 10px; transition: background .18s, border-color .18s, color .18s, transform .18s; }
.quiet-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.35); color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(118,240,231,.045); }
.quiet-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
.quiet-button:disabled { opacity: .35; }
.danger-quiet { color: #f09aa2; }
.execution-panel { padding: 20px 20px 15px; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.21); background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(16,32,41,.98), rgba(8,16,23,.99)); }
.execution-top { gap: 15px; }
.execution-state { font-size: 9px; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 4px; color: #b8cbd8; background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.23); }
.status-message { min-height: 42px; margin: 14px 0 16px; color: #b0c1cd; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; }
.primary-button {
  position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 54px; border-radius: 6px; gap: 12px; padding: 0 15px; font-size: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, #8bfff0, #55e0d5 48%, #38c5c2); color: #062126;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(49,191,191,.13), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.48);
  transition: filter .18s, transform .18s, box-shadow .18s;
}
.primary-button::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 25%, rgba(255,255,255,.19), transparent 65%); transform: translateX(-120%); transition: transform .65s ease; pointer-events: none; }
.primary-button:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(49,191,191,.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
.primary-button:hover::after { transform: translateX(120%); }
.primary-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.run-icon { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 27px; height: 27px; border-radius: 5px; border-color: rgba(6,33,38,.25); }
.button-arrow { font-size: 18px; }
.sim-controls { gap: 9px; margin-top: 10px; }
.execution-footer { color: #8298a8; font-size: 9px; margin-top: 15px; padding-top: 12px; }
.protocol-panel { gap: 12px; border-radius: 7px; padding: 15px 17px; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.15); background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(27,78,80,.12), rgba(10,20,27,.56)); }
.protocol-icon { width: 21px; height: 21px; flex-basis: 21px; font-size: 13px; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.3); }
.protocol-panel p { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.72; color: #9baebd; }
.protocol-panel strong { color: #d5e7ee; }
.footer { gap: 18px; padding: 25px 0 33px; margin-top: 14px; border-top-color: rgba(151,184,207,.16); }
.footer-brand { font-size: 11px; }
.footer-brand small { color: #8196a6; font-size: 9px; }
.footer > p { color: #899eae; font-size: 10px; }
.footer-actions { gap: 9px; }
.footer-actions button { color: #9fb1bf; font-size: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 4px; transition: color .18s, background .18s, border-color .18s; }
.footer-actions button:hover { color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(118,240,231,.045); }
.footer-actions #edit-button, .footer-actions #export-test-button { border-radius: 5px; padding: 9px 11px; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.24); background: rgba(118,240,231,.035); }
.toast { bottom: max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-radius: 7px; padding: 13px 17px; background: rgba(14,35,40,.96); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px); border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.3); font-size: 12px; box-shadow: 0 14px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
.toast.error { background: rgba(44,22,29,.97); border-color: rgba(255,127,142,.45); }
.first-run-guide { border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.16); background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgba(13,24,34,.96), rgba(10,17,25,.88)); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.1); }
.guide-heading, .guide-step { padding: 15px 17px; }
.guide-heading strong { font-size: 12px; color: #d8e5ed; }
.guide-step { transition: background .18s ease; }
.guide-step:hover { background: rgba(118,240,231,.025); }
.guide-step > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(118,240,231,.07); border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.16); color: var(--cyan); font-size: 10px; }
.guide-step strong { font-size: 11px; color: #d1dfe8; }
.guide-step small { color: #9aafbf; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.55; }
.research-tools { color: #9aafbf; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 32px; }
.research-tools summary { padding: 10px 0; }
.research-tools-body { border-radius: 7px; border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.19); background: rgba(12,20,29,.97); box-shadow: 0 15px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.15); padding: 16px; }
.research-tools-body p { color: #a3b4c1; line-height: 1.7; font-size: 11px; }
.research-tools-body button { border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; }

/* Larger hit areas, reduced visual noise, and predictable tablet/mobile flow. */
@media (max-width: 1150px) {
  .shell { width: calc(100% - 40px); }
  .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.18fr) minmax(325px, .9fr); gap: 14px; }
  .left-column, .right-column { gap: 14px; }
  .intro { gap: 22px; }
  .mission-stamp { min-width: 205px; }
  .guide-heading, .guide-step { padding: 13px 12px; }
  .guide-step { gap: 7px; }
  .guide-step small { font-size: 9px; }
  .agent-selectors { padding: 0 12px; }
  .agent-card { gap: 8px; padding: 11px 9px; }
  .agent-avatar { width: 34px; height: 39px; flex-basis: 34px; }
  .agent-info small { font-size: 8px; }
  .agent-info em { font-size: 9px; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); }
  .right-column { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); align-items: start; }
  .tools-panel { grid-row: span 2; }
  .execution-panel, .protocol-panel { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .intro { padding-top: 38px; }
  .first-run-guide { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .guide-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .topbar { min-height: 62px; padding: 0 16px; }
  .brand-word { font-size: 13px; }
  .top-meta { gap: 0; }
  .build-tag { font-size: 8px; padding: 7px 8px; }
  .eyebrow { display: none; }
  .shell { width: calc(100% - 24px); }
  .intro { padding: 29px 0 20px; display: block; }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(34px, 9.6vw, 47px); }
  .intro-text { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; }
  .mission-stamp { margin-top: 20px; min-width: 0; padding: 11px 0 0; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; }
  .mission-stamp::before { left: 0; top: -1px; width: 28px; height: 2px; }
  .stamp-label { grid-column: 1; }
  .mission-stamp strong { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; font-size: 10px; }
  .stamp-divider { display: none; }
  .stamp-small { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .mission-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; min-height: auto; border-radius: 7px; }
  .mission-title { flex: initial; grid-column: 1; gap: 10px; }
  .mission-index { font-size: 23px; }
  .mission-title strong { font-size: 12px; }
  .mission-strip > p { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 11px; }
  .tick-box { flex: initial; grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; padding-left: 12px; }
  .workspace { gap: 13px; }
  .left-column, .right-column { gap: 13px; }
  .first-run-guide { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); margin-bottom: 13px; }
  .guide-heading { grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 12px; }
  .guide-step { padding: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .guide-step:nth-child(3) { border-right: 0; }
  .guide-step:nth-child(4), .guide-step:nth-child(5) { border-bottom: 0; }
  .guide-step strong { font-size: 10px; }
  .guide-step small { font-size: 9px; }
  .right-column { display: flex; }
  .board-heading { padding: 16px 13px 13px; }
  .panel-heading h2, .execution-top h2 { font-size: 17px; }
  .board-meta { gap: 5px; }
  .map-chip { font-size: 7px; padding: 6px 5px; }
  .canvas-frame { margin: 0 8px; border-radius: 5px; }
  .canvas-corner { font-size: 6px; padding: 4px 5px; }
  .legend { padding: 12px; gap: 9px 12px; font-size: 9px; }
  .map-instruction { padding: 11px 13px 13px; font-size: 10px; }
  .compact-heading { padding: 15px 14px 13px; }
  .agent-selectors { padding: 0 11px; gap: 8px; }
  .agent-card { min-height: 78px; padding: 10px 8px; gap: 7px; }
  .agent-avatar { width: 30px; height: 35px; flex-basis: 30px; }
  .agent-info strong { font-size: 11px; }
  .agent-info small { font-size: 7px; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.35; }
  .agent-info em { font-size: 8px; }
  .selected-note { margin: 11px 11px 0; padding: 9px; }
  .subcopy { margin: -2px 14px 14px; }
  .action-grid { padding: 0 11px; }
  .queue-list-wrap { margin: 14px 11px 0; }
  .utility-actions { margin: 12px 11px 0; }
  .quiet-button { min-height: 36px; font-size: 10px; }
  .execution-panel { padding: 16px 13px 12px; }
  .status-message { font-size: 11px; }
  .primary-button { min-height: 51px; }
  .footer { gap: 12px; padding-top: 18px; }
  .footer-brand { flex: 1; }
  .footer-brand small { display: block; margin: 5px 0 0; }
  .footer > p { font-size: 9px; }
  .footer-actions { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; }
  .footer-actions button { white-space: normal; text-align: left; font-size: 10px; }
  .research-tools { margin-top: -3px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .research-tools summary { text-align: left; }
}
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .topbar { padding: 0 11px; }
  .brand { gap: 8px; }
  .brand-word { font-size: 11px; }
  .build-tag { font-size: 7px; padding: 6px; }
  .shell { width: calc(100% - 18px); }
  .agent-selectors { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); }
  .agent-card { min-height: 67px; }
  .board-meta .muted { display: none; }
  .guide-step { gap: 6px; padding: 9px 8px; }
  .guide-step > span { width: 19px; height: 19px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: .01ms !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; }
}

/* Quiet cinematic instrumentation in the negative space of the hero. */
.intro { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.intro-copy, .mission-stamp { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.intro::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  width: 186px; height: 186px; right: 250px; top: 5px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.105);
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(118,240,231,.06), transparent 63%), repeating-radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 0 22px, rgba(118,240,231,.055) 23px, transparent 24px 37px);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 36px rgba(118,240,231,.035), 0 0 65px rgba(31,126,135,.035);
  transform: rotate(-14deg);
}
.intro::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  width: 88px; height: 88px; right: 298px; top: 54px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239,189,114,.12);
  clip-path: polygon(25% 0,75% 0,100% 25%,100% 75%,75% 100%,25% 100%,0 75%,0 25%);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,189,114,.04), transparent 70%);
  transform: rotate(17deg);
}
@keyframes signal-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: .72; box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(118,240,231,.28); }
  50% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(118,240,231,.68); }
}
.live-dot, .map-chip-dot, .footer-dot { animation: signal-pulse 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .intro::after { right: 190px; width: 150px; height: 150px; top: 0; opacity: .75; }
  .intro::before { right: 230px; width: 68px; height: 68px; top: 43px; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .intro::before, .intro::after { display: none; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .live-dot, .map-chip-dot, .footer-dot { animation: none !important; }
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   CINEMATIC OPERATION DOSSIER · 0.4
   Original 2560×1440 scene art, local asset, no remote fonts or dependencies.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.cinematic-dossier {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  min-height: clamp(290px, 25vw, 390px);
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(126, 192, 218, .28);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #071019;
  box-shadow: 0 28px 74px rgba(0,0,0,.32), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  color: #f3f8fb;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}
.cinematic-dossier::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: inherit;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(214,241,255,.04), inset 0 -90px 100px rgba(1,7,12,.43), inset 0 24px 35px rgba(1,7,12,.2);
}
.dossier-art {
  position: absolute; z-index: -3; inset: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 48%;
  filter: saturate(.96) contrast(1.05) brightness(.83);
  transform: scale(1.015);
  animation: dossier-drift 32s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  user-select: none; pointer-events: none;
}
.dossier-vignette {
  position: absolute; z-index: -2; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5,12,19,.96) 0%, rgba(5,12,19,.82) 21%, rgba(5,12,19,.51) 43%, rgba(5,12,19,.10) 68%, rgba(5,12,19,.34) 100%),
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(4,9,15,.91) 0%, rgba(4,9,15,.44) 18%, transparent 50%, rgba(4,9,15,.33) 100%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 56% 45%, transparent 20%, rgba(0,5,10,.23) 90%);
}
.dossier-topline {
  position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 21px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(157,207,233,.16);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(2,9,15,.7), rgba(2,9,15,.12));
  font: 9px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .15em; color: #b6cad7;
}
.dossier-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.dossier-mark i { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: 0 0 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 13px rgba(118,240,231,.7); animation: signal-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.dossier-mark b { color: #7f9caf; font-weight: 400; }
.dossier-classification { color: #91a9ba; font-size: 8px; white-space: nowrap; }
.dossier-classification i { color: var(--amber); font-style: normal; margin-left: 8px; }
.dossier-content { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 700px; padding: 77px 0 62px 28px; }
.dossier-kicker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 12px; color: #c0d3df; font: 9px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .2em; text-shadow: 0 2px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.8); }
.dossier-pulse { display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 1px; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(118,240,231,.7); }
.dossier-content h2 { margin: 0; max-width: 740px; font-size: clamp(27px, 3.2vw, 47px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.055em; text-wrap: balance; text-shadow: 0 4px 27px rgba(0,0,0,.7); }
.dossier-content h2 em { display: block; margin-top: 5px; color: var(--cyan); font-style: normal; text-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(118,240,231,.16), 0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.8); }
.dossier-content p { max-width: 530px; margin: 13px 0 15px; color: #d0dde5; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.88); }
.dossier-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; }
.dossier-tags span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 25px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(168,208,229,.23); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(4,12,19,.59); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #c7d9e4; font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.dossier-tags i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); }
.dossier-tags .tag-amber { background: var(--amber); }
.dossier-tags .tag-red { background: var(--red); }
.dossier-side {
  position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 20px; top: 74px; width: 210px; padding: 14px 15px 13px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(143,194,220,.26); border-radius: 7px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(4,12,20,.82), rgba(5,13,21,.55));
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  backdrop-filter: blur(11px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(11px);
}
.dossier-reticle { position: relative; width: 66px; height: 66px; margin: 0 auto 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.3); border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(118,240,231,.1), transparent 68%); }
.dossier-reticle::before, .dossier-reticle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: rgba(118,240,231,.5); }
.dossier-reticle::before { width: 84px; height: 1px; }
.dossier-reticle::after { height: 84px; width: 1px; }
.dossier-reticle span { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--cyan); transform: rotate(45deg); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(118,240,231,.15); }
.dossier-reticle i, .dossier-reticle b { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--amber); }
.dossier-reticle i { top: 10px; right: 10px; }
.dossier-reticle b { bottom: 10px; left: 10px; background: var(--cyan); }
.dossier-side-label { margin-bottom: 8px; color: #93aaba; font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .15em; }
.dossier-signal-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 0 6px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.13); font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.dossier-signal-row span { color: #9aaebd; }
.dossier-signal-row strong { color: var(--cyan); font-weight: 500; text-align: right; }
.dossier-signal-row strong.warning { color: var(--amber); }
.dossier-signal-row strong.danger { color: var(--red); }
.dossier-bottomline { position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: 21px; right: 21px; bottom: 0; min-height: 39px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(157,207,233,.19); color: #9bb2c1; font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .14em; }
.dossier-bottomline b { margin-left: 9px; color: #668497; font-weight: 400; }
.dossier-bottomline i { margin: 0 6px; color: var(--cyan); font-style: normal; }
.dossier-corner { position: absolute; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.8); border-style: solid; }
.dossier-corner-tl { top: 6px; left: 6px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; }
.dossier-corner-br { right: 6px; bottom: 6px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; }
@keyframes dossier-drift { from { transform: scale(1.015) translate3d(0,0,0); } to { transform: scale(1.065) translate3d(-.45%,.35%,0); } }
@keyframes dossier-line-sweep { from { transform: translateY(-100%); opacity: 0; } 15% { opacity: .45; } 85% { opacity: .2; } to { transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; } }
.cinematic-dossier::after { content: ""; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -20%; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(118,240,231,.32), transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(118,240,231,.18); animation: dossier-line-sweep 11s ease-in-out infinite; }

/* The playable board receives a restrained cinematic HUD treatment without
   compromising grid contrast or the hit target size. */
.canvas-frame { border-color: rgba(118,180,210,.27); background: #061019; }
.canvas-frame::before { content: ""; z-index: 1; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(168,222,241,.018) 0, rgba(168,222,241,.018) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 4px); opacity: .35; mix-blend-mode: screen; }
.canvas-frame::after { z-index: 2; box-shadow: inset 0 0 48px rgba(0,3,8,.27), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05); }
.canvas-corner { z-index: 3; }
.panel { box-shadow: 0 20px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.22), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.03); }
.panel-heading h2, .execution-top h2 { text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.24); }
.action-button:focus-visible, .agent-card:focus-visible, .quiet-button:focus-visible, .primary-button:focus-visible, .footer-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }
@media (max-width: 1040px) {
  .dossier-side { right: 14px; width: 180px; padding: 12px; }
  .dossier-content { max-width: calc(100% - 205px); padding-left: 21px; }
  .dossier-content h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 39px); }
  .dossier-content p { max-width: 470px; }
}
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .cinematic-dossier { min-height: 360px; margin-bottom: 14px; border-radius: 8px; }
  .dossier-art { object-position: 47% center; }
  .dossier-vignette { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(4,10,17,.91), rgba(4,10,17,.52) 60%, rgba(4,10,17,.27)), linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(4,9,15,.94), transparent 57%, rgba(4,9,15,.43)); }
  .dossier-topline { padding: 13px 14px; font-size: 8px; }
  .dossier-classification { font-size: 7px; }
  .dossier-content { max-width: calc(100% - 20px); padding: 65px 15px 89px; }
  .dossier-kicker { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .12em; }
  .dossier-content h2 { max-width: 470px; font-size: clamp(26px, 6vw, 38px); }
  .dossier-content p { max-width: 460px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; }
  .dossier-tags { gap: 5px; }
  .dossier-tags span { min-height: 23px; padding: 5px 6px; font-size: 7px; }
  .dossier-side { right: 12px; top: auto; bottom: 51px; width: 150px; padding: 8px 10px; background: rgba(4,12,20,.75); }
  .dossier-reticle { width: 36px; height: 36px; margin: 0 auto 5px; }
  .dossier-reticle::before { width: 48px; }
  .dossier-reticle::after { height: 48px; }
  .dossier-reticle span { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
  .dossier-reticle i { top: 5px; right: 5px; }
  .dossier-reticle b { bottom: 5px; left: 5px; }
  .dossier-side-label { margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 7px; }
  .dossier-signal-row { padding: 5px 0 4px; font-size: 7px; }
  .dossier-bottomline { left: 13px; right: 13px; min-height: 34px; font-size: 7px; letter-spacing: .08em; }
  .dossier-bottomline b { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .cinematic-dossier { min-height: 400px; }
  .dossier-art { object-position: 46% center; }
  .dossier-content { padding: 62px 13px 145px; max-width: 100%; }
  .dossier-content h2 { font-size: clamp(25px, 7.3vw, 33px); }
  .dossier-content p { max-width: 100%; }
  .dossier-side { left: 13px; right: 13px; bottom: 45px; width: auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0 10px; padding: 6px 9px; }
  .dossier-reticle { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 3; margin: 0; }
  .dossier-side-label { grid-column: 2; margin: 0 0 3px; }
  .dossier-signal-row { grid-column: 2; padding: 2px 0; font-size: 7px; }
  .dossier-bottomline { font-size: 6px; }
  .dossier-classification { letter-spacing: .04em; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .dossier-art, .cinematic-dossier::after, .dossier-mark i { animation: none !important; }
}


/* Character dossier portraits — locally bundled artwork, not remote avatar APIs. */
.agent-avatar { isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; background: #071019; border-radius: 7px; }
.agent-portrait { position: absolute; z-index: 0; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 35%; filter: saturate(.82) contrast(1.13) brightness(.82); transition: filter .2s ease, transform .3s ease; }
.agent-avatar::after { content: ""; z-index: 1; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(3,10,16,.74), transparent 65%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(3,10,16,.12), transparent 80%); }
.agent-avatar > span { position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: 3px; bottom: 3px; width: 13px; height: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(231,245,252,.23); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(3,10,16,.84); color: #f0fcff; font: 800 8px var(--mono); }
.agent-avatar i { z-index: 3; left: auto; right: 4px; bottom: 5px; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 7px currentColor; }
.agent-card:hover .agent-portrait, .agent-card.selected .agent-portrait { filter: saturate(1.02) contrast(1.12) brightness(.96); transform: scale(1.045); }
.mira-avatar { border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.55); }
.kite-avatar { border-color: rgba(184,170,255,.5); }
.kite-avatar::after { background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(3,8,18,.76), transparent 65%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(29,19,55,.15), transparent 80%); }
.agent-info { z-index: 1; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .agent-avatar { border-radius: 6px; }
  .agent-portrait { object-position: center 34%; }
}


/* Cinematic end-of-operation slate: clear result, restrained bloom, no modal trap. */
.mission-outcome {
  position: absolute; z-index: 4; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px; text-align: center; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(5,16,23,.58), rgba(3,8,14,.88) 70%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  animation: outcome-in .45s cubic-bezier(.18,.72,.22,1) both;
}
.mission-outcome::before, .mission-outcome::after { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none; }
.mission-outcome::before { width: min(68%, 480px); aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.2); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 24px rgba(118,240,231,.018), 0 0 0 48px rgba(118,240,231,.012), inset 0 0 55px rgba(118,240,231,.035); }
.mission-outcome::after { width: 100%; height: 1px; left: -100%; top: 50%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(118,240,231,.7), transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(118,240,231,.2); animation: outcome-sweep 1.4s ease-out .1s both; }
.outcome-kicker { font: 9px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .24em; color: var(--cyan); text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(118,240,231,.24); }
.outcome-title, .mission-outcome strong { margin-top: 14px; max-width: 100%; color: #f1f8fc; font-size: clamp(19px, 3.1vw, 36px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.045em; text-wrap: balance; text-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.75); }
.outcome-divider { width: 55px; height: 2px; margin: 16px 0 12px; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 17px rgba(118,240,231,.45); }
.mission-outcome p { max-width: 90%; margin: 0; color: #b8cbd8; font: 9px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .11em; line-height: 1.8; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.mission-outcome[data-outcome="failed"] { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(38,9,17,.65), rgba(12,5,11,.91) 72%); }
.mission-outcome[data-outcome="failed"]::before { border-color: rgba(255,127,142,.22); box-shadow: 0 0 0 24px rgba(255,127,142,.018), 0 0 0 48px rgba(255,127,142,.012), inset 0 0 55px rgba(255,127,142,.035); }
.mission-outcome[data-outcome="failed"]::after { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,127,142,.7), transparent); }
.mission-outcome[data-outcome="failed"] .outcome-kicker { color: var(--red); }
.mission-outcome[data-outcome="failed"] .outcome-divider { background: var(--red); box-shadow: 0 0 17px rgba(255,127,142,.35); }
@keyframes outcome-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.025); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
@keyframes outcome-sweep { from { left: -100%; opacity: 0; } 25% { opacity: .8; } to { left: 100%; opacity: 0; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .mission-outcome, .mission-outcome::after { animation: none !important; } }
.dossier-signal-row strong.success { color: var(--green); }

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   TACTICAL READOUT + PLAN PREFLIGHT · 0.5
   Decision-support visuals are driven by the deterministic local simulation.
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.map-telemetry {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(110px, .7fr) minmax(0, 1.08fr);
  margin: 0 17px 13px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(119,164,191,.18);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: linear-gradient(110deg, rgba(8,18,27,.96), rgba(14,27,38,.8) 54%, rgba(8,16,24,.95));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.028), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.telemetry-cell { min-width: 0; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 11px 13px 10px; }
.telemetry-cell + .telemetry-cell { border-left: 1px solid rgba(144,181,203,.12); }
.telemetry-cell::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(118,240,231,.24), transparent); opacity: .7; }
.telemetry-label { color: #829bad; font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .14em; line-height: 1.45; }
.telemetry-cell > strong { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; color: #e9f5fa; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .03em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.telemetry-cell > strong small { color: #8198aa; font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.telemetry-cell > small { color: #879dad; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.telemetry-security > strong { color: var(--amber); font-size: 10px; }
.telemetry-security > strong.security-pass { color: var(--green); }
.telemetry-security > small { color: #9bb0bf; }
.operative-telemetry > strong { color: var(--cyan); font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .15em; }

.plan-preflight {
  position: relative;
  margin: 16px 16px 0;
  padding: 14px 13px 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(119,164,191,.2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 0 0, rgba(54,137,148,.11), transparent 58%), linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(9,19,28,.95), rgba(7,13,21,.98));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025), 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}
.plan-preflight::before { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -42px; top: -64px; width: 130px; height: 130px; pointer-events: none; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.08); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 16px rgba(118,240,231,.018), 0 0 0 33px rgba(118,240,231,.012); }
.preflight-heading { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.preflight-emblem { width: 27px; height: 27px; flex: 0 0 27px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.32); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(118,240,231,.055); }
.preflight-emblem::before, .preflight-emblem::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.68); transform: rotate(45deg); }
.preflight-emblem::before { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
.preflight-emblem::after { width: 3px; height: 3px; background: var(--cyan); }
.preflight-heading > div { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.preflight-heading .field-label { font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .14em; }
.preflight-heading strong { color: #e1eef4; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .09em; font-weight: 800; }
.preflight-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: 0 0 6px; margin-left: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: #718796; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(113,135,150,.08); }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="pass"] .preflight-status-dot { background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(143,232,189,.55), 0 0 0 4px rgba(143,232,189,.07); }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="risk"] .preflight-status-dot { background: var(--red); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,127,142,.45), 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,127,142,.07); }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="incomplete"] .preflight-status-dot { background: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(239,189,114,.4), 0 0 0 4px rgba(239,189,114,.07); }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="running"] .preflight-status-dot { background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(118,240,231,.45); }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="pass"] .preflight-heading strong { color: var(--green); }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="risk"] .preflight-heading strong { color: #ffadb6; }
.plan-preflight[data-forecast="incomplete"] .preflight-heading strong { color: var(--amber); }
.preflight-detail { position: relative; min-height: 32px; margin: 11px 0 12px; color: #9eb2c0; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.preflight-checks { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); border-top: 1px solid rgba(140,177,199,.13); }
.preflight-check { min-width: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 23px minmax(0,1fr) 17px; gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(140,177,199,.095); }
.preflight-check:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.check-index { color: #6f8b9f; font: 8px var(--mono); }
.check-copy { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.check-copy b { color: #d9e7ef; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }
.check-copy small { color: #8199aa; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.preflight-check > i { width: 17px; height: 17px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(130,157,175,.22); border-radius: 50%; color: #829aaa; font: normal 9px var(--mono); }
.preflight-check[data-state="pass"] > i { border-color: rgba(143,232,189,.42); color: var(--green); background: rgba(143,232,189,.07); }
.preflight-check[data-state="pass"] .check-copy small { color: #9bd6bb; }
.preflight-check[data-state="risk"] > i { border-color: rgba(255,127,142,.44); color: var(--red); background: rgba(255,127,142,.07); }
.preflight-check[data-state="risk"] .check-copy small { color: #ed9ba4; }
.preflight-check[data-state="pending"] > i { color: #6f8493; }
.preflight-footnote { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 10px 0 11px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(140,177,199,.08); color: #607a8d; font: 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .075em; }

/* More cinematic separation, sharper active states, calmer information hierarchy. */
.panel { background: linear-gradient(146deg, rgba(18,31,44,.98), rgba(8,15,23,.99) 78%); }
.board-panel { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 0, rgba(40,103,119,.08), transparent 47%), linear-gradient(146deg, rgba(15,29,41,.98), rgba(7,14,22,.99) 80%); }
.agent-card.selected { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(118,240,231,.12), 0 9px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.18), 0 0 22px rgba(118,240,231,.035); }
.action-button:disabled small { color: #8797a4; }
.action-button:disabled { border-color: rgba(151,184,207,.1); }
.primary-button { box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(72,219,209,.11), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22); }
.primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) { box-shadow: 0 11px 28px rgba(72,219,209,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25); }
.mission-strip, .first-run-guide { backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }

@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .map-telemetry { margin: 0 10px 10px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(80px,.62fr) minmax(0,1fr); }
  .telemetry-cell { padding: 9px 8px; gap: 4px; }
  .telemetry-label { font-size: 7px; letter-spacing: .08em; }
  .telemetry-cell > strong { font-size: 10px; }
  .telemetry-cell > strong small { font-size: 7px; }
  .telemetry-cell > small { font-size: 8px; }
  .plan-preflight { margin: 14px 10px 0; padding: 12px 11px 0; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .map-telemetry { margin: 0 8px 8px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(64px,.58fr) minmax(0,1fr); }
  .telemetry-cell { padding: 8px 6px; }
  .telemetry-cell > strong { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .telemetry-label { font-size: 6px; }
  .telemetry-cell > small { font-size: 7px; }
  .preflight-footnote { font-size: 6px; letter-spacing: .035em; }
}
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .map-telemetry { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(58px,.54fr) minmax(0,1fr); }
  .telemetry-cell { padding-left: 5px; padding-right: 5px; }
  .telemetry-security > strong { font-size: 8px; }
  .preflight-footnote { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .plan-preflight, .preflight-emblem, .preflight-status-dot { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}


/* Version 0.6 — measured runtime diagnostics and tactically meaningful movement controls. */
.speed-control {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px 12px;
  margin-top: 11px;
  padding: 11px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.15);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(24,59,68,.24), rgba(9,17,26,.74));
}
.speed-control[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.speed-control > span { color: #91a8b8; font: 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .13em; }
.speed-control select {
  width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 8px 9px;
  color: #e6f6f8; font: 10px var(--mono);
  border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.28); border-radius: 4px;
  background: #0b1a24; outline: none;
}
.speed-control select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }
.speed-control small { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: #718b9d; font-size: 9px; }
.diagnostics-panel {
  position: relative; margin: 18px 0 30px; border: 1px solid rgba(123,166,191,.17);
  border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(13,25,36,.93), rgba(7,13,21,.98));  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025), 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.11); overflow: hidden;
}
.diagnostics-panel > summary {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; min-height: 66px;
  padding: 14px 17px; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
}
.diagnostics-panel > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.diagnostics-panel > summary::after { content: '+'; color: var(--cyan); font: 20px var(--mono); margin-left: 2px; }
.diagnostics-panel[open] > summary::after { content: '−'; }
.diagnostics-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.diagnostics-title > i { width: 9px; height: 9px; flex: 0 0 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(118,240,231,.48); }
.diagnostics-title > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; }
.diagnostics-title b { color: #dceaf2; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .045em; }
.diagnostics-title small { color: #70889b; font: 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .11em; }
.diagnostics-live-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-left: auto; color: #7e98a9; font: 9px var(--mono); white-space: nowrap; }
.diagnostics-live-summary b { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }
.diagnostics-live-summary i { width: 1px; height: 13px; background: rgba(128,164,187,.24); }
.diagnostics-body { padding: 0 17px 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(128,164,187,.13); }
.diagnostics-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 8px; padding-top: 14px; }
.diagnostic-metric { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(127,167,191,.13); border-radius: 5px; background: linear-gradient(142deg, rgba(18,34,47,.7), rgba(8,15,22,.84)); }
.diagnostic-metric > span { color: #728c9e; font: 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .09em; }
.diagnostic-metric > strong { color: #e1eef5; font: 700 16px var(--mono); letter-spacing: -.025em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.diagnostic-metric > small { color: #6e8597; font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.45; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.diagnostics-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(128,164,187,.12); }
.diagnostics-footer p { max-width: 700px; margin: 0; color: #738b9d; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.6; }
.diagnostics-footer .quiet-button { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #98deda; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.24); background: rgba(118,240,231,.055); }
.diagnostics-footer .quiet-button[aria-pressed="false"] { color: #b0bac3; border-color: rgba(144,165,181,.2); }
.diagnostics-panel button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }
.canvas-frame canvas { touch-action: manipulation; }
.agent-card, .action-button, .quiet-button, .primary-button, .research-tools-body button { transition: transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background-color .18s ease; }
.agent-card:active, .action-button:active:not(:disabled), .quiet-button:active:not(:disabled), .primary-button:active:not(:disabled), .research-tools-body button:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.995); }
.log-entry { animation: log-enter .24s ease both; }
@keyframes log-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .diagnostics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .diagnostics-panel > summary { padding: 12px; gap: 9px; }
  .diagnostics-live-summary { gap: 6px; font-size: 8px; }
  .diagnostics-title b { font-size: 10px; }
  .diagnostics-body { padding: 0 12px 13px; }
  .diagnostics-footer { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .diagnostics-footer .quiet-button { width: 100%; }
}
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .diagnostics-live-summary { display: none; }
  .diagnostics-grid { gap: 6px; }
  .diagnostic-metric { padding: 10px 8px; }
  .diagnostic-metric > strong { font-size: 14px; }
  .speed-control { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); }
  .speed-control small { grid-column: auto; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .agent-card, .action-button, .quiet-button, .primary-button, .research-tools-body button { transition: none !important; }
  .log-entry { animation: none !important; }
}


/* A restrained, composited surveillance sweep: atmosphere without another canvas redraw. */
.canvas-sweep {
  z-index: 1; position: absolute; top: -38%; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 38%;
  pointer-events: none; opacity: .78; mix-blend-mode: screen;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(72,183,219,.025) 35%, rgba(118,240,231,.075) 68%, transparent);
  animation: canvas-surveillance-sweep 8.5s cubic-bezier(.35,0,.62,1) infinite;
}
@keyframes canvas-surveillance-sweep { from { transform: translateY(0); } to { transform: translateY(365%); } }
body[data-motion="off"] .canvas-sweep { animation: none !important; opacity: 0; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .canvas-sweep { animation: none !important; opacity: .28; } }


/* RELEASE 0.7 — post-mission evidence review and precision queue editing */
.queue-list li { grid-template-columns: 25px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 22px; }
.step-remove {
  display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0;
  border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.13); border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); color: #8da2b2; cursor: pointer;
