  font: 500 15px/1 var(--mono); transition: color .16s, background .16s, border-color .16s;
}
.step-remove:hover:not(:disabled), .step-remove:focus-visible {
  outline: none; border-color: rgba(255,127,142,.42); background: rgba(255,127,142,.09); color: #ff9aa4;
}
.step-remove:disabled { opacity: .28; cursor: not-allowed; }
.replay-panel {
  overflow: hidden; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.22);
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 0, rgba(61,171,176,.11), transparent 44%), linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(15,29,41,.98), rgba(7,14,22,.99));
  animation: replay-panel-in .36s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.replay-panel[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.replay-heading { align-items: center; }
.replay-state-label { padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.18); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(118,240,231,.045); font: 600 9px var(--mono); white-space: nowrap; }
.replay-copy { margin: -3px 18px 14px; color: #9aafbe; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; }
.replay-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(80px, 1fr) auto; gap: 9px; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; }
.replay-step { min-height: 34px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 7px 10px; }
.replay-scrubber { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(50px, 1fr) auto; gap: 9px; align-items: center; min-width: 0; color: #8fa6b7; font: 600 9px var(--mono); }
.replay-scrubber input[type="range"] { width: 100%; min-width: 0; accent-color: var(--cyan); cursor: pointer; }
.replay-scrubber input[type="range"]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(118,240,231,.7); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }
.replay-event { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; margin: 14px 16px 0; padding: 12px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.11); border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.17); }
.replay-event-dot { flex: 0 0 7px; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-top: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(118,240,231,.45); }
.replay-event p { margin: 0; color: #c1d0da; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.replay-footnote { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin: 12px 16px 15px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.09); color: #688397; font: 600 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.execution-state.reviewing { color: #d8c49c; border-color: rgba(239,189,114,.27); background: rgba(239,189,114,.07); }
@keyframes replay-panel-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
@media (max-width: 580px) {
  .replay-controls { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; padding: 0 11px; }
  .replay-scrubber { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; padding: 5px 0 7px; }
  .replay-step { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; }
  .replay-copy { margin-left: 13px; margin-right: 13px; }
  .replay-event { margin-left: 11px; margin-right: 11px; }
  .replay-footnote { margin-left: 11px; margin-right: 11px; font-size: 7px; }
  .queue-list li { grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 22px; gap: 5px; padding: 5px; }
  .queue-list .step-kind { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .replay-panel { animation: none !important; } }

/* RELEASE 0.8 — interactive tactical layers and cinematic evidence playback */
.board-head-tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; }
.board-layer-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.map-layer-toggle {
  min-height: 25px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 7px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(145,174,194,.15); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(3,10,16,.28);
  color: #6e8495; cursor: pointer; font: 600 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .04em;
  transition: border-color .16s, background .16s, color .16s, box-shadow .16s;
}
.map-layer-toggle i { display: block; width: 5px; height: 5px; flex: 0 0 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: .42; }
.map-layer-toggle:hover, .map-layer-toggle:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: rgba(102,230,224,.45); color: #c5dbe6; }
.map-layer-toggle.active { color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(102,230,224,.07); border-color: rgba(102,230,224,.29); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(102,230,224,.025); }
.map-layer-toggle.active i { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 9px currentColor; }
.map-layer-toggle.camera-layer.active { color: var(--amber); background: rgba(228,174,97,.07); border-color: rgba(228,174,97,.3); }
.map-layer-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }

.replay-transport { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px 0; }
.replay-play-button { min-height: 34px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.35); border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(37,132,138,.17), rgba(14,42,52,.28)); color: var(--cyan); cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, transform .15s; }
.replay-play-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(102,230,224,.12); border-color: rgba(102,230,224,.64); }
.replay-play-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
.replay-play-button:focus-visible, .replay-home:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }
.replay-play-button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.replay-rate-label { margin-left: auto; color: #6e8597; font: 600 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .07em; }
.replay-speed { min-width: 63px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.18); border-radius: 4px; background: #0b1721; color: #bed0dc; font: 600 10px var(--mono); }
.replay-speed:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }
.replay-home { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 9px; font-size: 9px; }
.replay-home:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: default; }
.replay-milestones { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 16px 1px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(102,230,224,.2) transparent; }
.replay-milestones[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.replay-milestone { flex: 0 0 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.12); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); color: #98adbc; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s, color .15s; }
.replay-milestone small { font: 600 8px var(--mono); color: #6f8799; white-space: nowrap; }
.replay-milestone span { font-size: 9px; white-space: nowrap; }
.replay-milestone.success { border-color: rgba(136,229,182,.2); }
.replay-milestone.success small { color: var(--green); }
.replay-milestone.warning { border-color: rgba(228,174,97,.23); }
.replay-milestone.warning small { color: var(--amber); }
.replay-milestone.danger { border-color: rgba(255,111,121,.28); }
.replay-milestone.danger small { color: var(--red); }
.replay-milestone:hover, .replay-milestone.current { background: rgba(102,230,224,.08); border-color: rgba(102,230,224,.52); color: #eaf6fa; }
.replay-milestone.current { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(102,230,224,.6); }
.replay-milestone:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .board-heading { align-items: flex-start; }
  .board-head-tools { max-width: 62%; }
}
@media (max-width: 580px) {
  .board-head-tools { gap: 5px; max-width: 69%; }
  .board-layer-controls { gap: 4px; }
  .map-layer-toggle { min-height: 25px; padding: 4px 5px; gap: 4px; font-size: 7px; }
  .board-meta { gap: 4px; }
  .board-meta .map-chip { font-size: 6px; }
  .replay-transport { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 11px 0; }
  .replay-play-button { min-height: 39px; flex: 1 1 155px; text-align: center; }
  .replay-rate-label { margin-left: 0; }
  .replay-speed { min-height: 37px; }
  .replay-home { min-height: 37px; flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .replay-milestones { padding-left: 11px; padding-right: 11px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .map-layer-toggle, .replay-play-button, .replay-milestone { transition: none !important; }
}


/* RELEASE 0.9 — performance-aware presentation and renderer health state */
.diagnostics-health {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 4px 7px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(128,164,187,.2); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(128,164,187,.045);
  color: #92a8b8; font: 700 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .055em; white-space: nowrap;
}
.diagnostics-health[data-health="stable"] { color: var(--green); border-color: rgba(143,232,189,.24); background: rgba(143,232,189,.055); }
.diagnostics-health[data-health="watch"] { color: var(--amber); border-color: rgba(239,189,114,.26); background: rgba(239,189,114,.055); }
.diagnostics-health[data-health="slow"] { color: #ff9da5; border-color: rgba(255,127,142,.3); background: rgba(255,127,142,.065); }
.diagnostic-metric:has(#diag-cache-reuse) > strong { color: var(--cyan); }
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .diagnostics-live-summary { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .diagnostics-health { min-height: 20px; font-size: 6px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .diagnostics-health { transition: none !important; } }


/* RELEASE 0.9 — explicit graphics budget controls */
.diagnostics-controls { display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 9px; flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 250px; }
.quality-control { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; min-width: 190px; max-width: 250px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.14); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(118,240,231,.025); }
.quality-control > span { color: #7891a3; font: 700 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .09em; }
.quality-control select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 31px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.2); border-radius: 3px; background: #0b1721; color: #d8e8f0; font: 600 9px var(--mono); }
.quality-control select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 2px; }
.quality-control small { color: #688397; font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.4; }
.diagnostics-controls .quiet-button { align-self: center; max-width: 205px; white-space: normal; }
body[data-graphics="performance"] .canvas-sweep { opacity: 0 !important; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .diagnostics-controls { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 100%; justify-content: stretch; }
  .quality-control { flex: 1 1 220px; max-width: none; }
  .diagnostics-controls .quiet-button { flex: 1 1 180px; max-width: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 740px) {
  .diagnostics-controls { flex-direction: column; }
  .quality-control { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
  .diagnostics-controls .quiet-button { width: 100%; max-width: none; }
}

/* RELEASE 1.0 — playable signal-routing hack, local draft status and optional sound cues */
.sound-toggle { color: #7e95a6; }
.sound-toggle.active { color: var(--green); border-color: rgba(143,232,189,.35); background: rgba(143,232,189,.06); }
.sound-toggle.active i { box-shadow: 0 0 9px currentColor; opacity: 1; }
.draft-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 12px 0 8px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.12); background: rgba(118,240,231,.025); color: #668398; font: 700 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .06em; line-height: 1.45; }
.draft-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 6px; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 9px rgba(118,240,231,.4); }
.draft-status[data-state="saved"] { color: #8fc8ba; border-color: rgba(143,232,189,.18); }
.draft-status[data-state="saved"] .draft-status-dot { background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(143,232,189,.35); }
.draft-status[data-state="unavailable"] { color: #e3b77f; border-color: rgba(239,189,114,.18); }
.draft-status[data-state="unavailable"] .draft-status-dot { background: var(--amber); }

.hack-console { position: fixed; z-index: 1000; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 14px max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); overflow-y: auto; }
.hack-console[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.hack-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(2,7,12,.86); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); animation: hack-scrim-in .18s ease-out both; }
.hack-dialog { position: relative; width: min(100%, 470px); max-height: min(92dvh, 850px); overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.27); border-radius: 7px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(30,99,111,.17), transparent 44%), linear-gradient(155deg, #101e29, #071019 66%); box-shadow: 0 36px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.58), 0 0 46px rgba(118,240,231,.055); animation: hack-dialog-in .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both; }
.hack-dialog-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.13); color: #81a8b8; font: 700 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.hack-dialog-top > span { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.hack-dialog-top > span i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 9px var(--cyan); }
.hack-close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.15); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); color: #b9cfdb; font-size: 22px; cursor: pointer; }
.hack-close:hover, .hack-close:focus-visible { color: #fff; border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.48); outline: none; }
.hack-dialog-content { padding: 21px clamp(16px, 5vw, 27px) 18px; }
.hack-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; margin-bottom: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.32); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--cyan); background: linear-gradient(140deg, rgba(118,240,231,.13), rgba(118,240,231,.02)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(118,240,231,.045), 0 0 22px rgba(118,240,231,.035); font-size: 28px; }
.hack-dialog-content > .field-label { color: #6d98aa; }
.hack-dialog h2 { margin: 7px 0 9px; color: #eef7fa; font-size: clamp(22px, 5vw, 29px); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
.hack-dialog-content > p { margin: 0; color: #8fa7b5; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; }
.hack-state-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 17px 0 12px; min-height: 32px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.12); background: rgba(118,240,231,.035); }
.hack-state-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: 0 0 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(118,240,231,.42); }
.hack-state-row strong { flex: 1; min-width: 0; color: var(--cyan); font: 700 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .06em; }
.hack-state-row small { color: #70899a; font: 700 8px var(--mono); white-space: nowrap; }
.hack-state-row [data-state="error"] { color: var(--red); }
.hack-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; width: min(100%, 330px); margin: 0 auto; }
.signal-node { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; min-height: clamp(62px, 15vw, 84px); border: 1px solid rgba(123,163,187,.23); border-radius: 5px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(18,39,52,.92), rgba(5,15,23,.95)); color: #a5bdcb; cursor: pointer; font: 700 19px var(--mono); transition: background .13s ease, border-color .13s ease, color .13s ease, box-shadow .13s ease, transform .13s ease; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; touch-action: manipulation; }
.signal-node span { color: #668092; font: 700 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .1em; }
.signal-node:hover { border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.5); color: #f0fbfd; }
.signal-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }
.signal-node.start-node { border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.4); color: var(--cyan); }
.signal-node.target-node { border-color: rgba(143,232,189,.32); color: var(--green); }
.signal-node.blocked-node { color: #e87983; border-color: rgba(255,127,142,.35); background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(105,30,43,.28) 0 6px, rgba(23,15,22,.96) 6px 12px); cursor: pointer; }
.signal-node.blocked-node::after { content: "×"; position: absolute; right: 7px; top: 4px; color: var(--red); font-size: 11px; }
.signal-node.is-path { border-color: rgba(118,240,231,.66); background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(27,107,113,.35), rgba(8,35,43,.95)); color: #ecffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(118,240,231,.085), 0 0 14px rgba(118,240,231,.06); }
.signal-node.is-path::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 6px; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 7px var(--cyan); }
.signal-node.is-current { outline: 1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.6); outline-offset: 2px; }
.signal-node.target-node.is-path { border-color: rgba(143,232,189,.76); color: var(--green); box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(143,232,189,.08), 0 0 14px rgba(143,232,189,.06); }
.hack-path-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 11px 1px 13px; color: #6d8798; font: 700 8px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .07em; }
.hack-path-row strong { color: #aadad8; text-align: right; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.hack-dialog-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
.hack-dialog-actions > button { min-height: 44px; justify-content: center; }
.hack-cancel { padding: 10px 14px; }
.hack-footnote { margin-top: 15px !important; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(151,184,207,.1); color: #506d7f !important; font: 700 7px var(--mono); letter-spacing: .05em; }
.hack-console.hack-error-flash .hack-dialog { animation: hack-error .2s ease-out; }
@keyframes hack-scrim-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes hack-dialog-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
@keyframes hack-error { 0%,100% { transform: translateX(0); } 25% { transform: translateX(-4px); } 70% { transform: translateX(4px); } }
body.hack-console-open { overflow: hidden; }
@media (max-width: 580px) {
  .board-layer-controls { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .map-layer-toggle { min-height: 34px; font-size: 8px; padding: 6px 7px; }
  .hack-console { padding-left: 9px; padding-right: 9px; }
  .hack-dialog { max-height: calc(100dvh - 22px); }
  .hack-dialog-content { padding-top: 17px; }
  .hack-grid { gap: 7px; }
  .signal-node { min-height: 65px; font-size: 18px; }
  .hack-state-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .hack-state-row strong { flex-basis: calc(100% - 25px); }
  .hack-state-row small { margin-left: 14px; }
}
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .hack-dialog-content { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px; }
  .signal-node { min-height: 56px; }
  .hack-dialog-actions { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hack-scrim, .hack-dialog, .hack-console.hack-error-flash .hack-dialog { animation: none !important; }
  .signal-node { transition: none !important; }
}

/* REAL-TIME WEBGL TACTICAL SCENE / RELEASE 1.1 */
.canvas-frame[data-view="3d"] { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 45% 42%, #102b39 0%, #07121c 67%, #03080e 100%); }
.canvas-frame[data-view="2d"] #scene3d-board,
.canvas-frame[data-view="3d"] #game-board,
.canvas-frame canvas[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.canvas-frame #scene3d-board {
  display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: #061019;
  touch-action: none; cursor: grab; outline: none;
}
.canvas-frame #scene3d-board:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.canvas-frame #scene3d-board:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: -3px; }
.scene3d-hud {
  display: none; position: absolute; z-index: 4; inset: 0 0 auto 0; padding: 11px 12px;
  justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; pointer-events: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(102,230,224,.12); color: rgba(191,224,238,.78);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(3,9,14,.72), rgba(3,9,14,0));
  font: 700 8px/1.4 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .13em; text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.9);
}
.canvas-frame[data-view="3d"] .scene3d-hud { display: flex; }
.scene3d-hud span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.scene3d-hud span:first-child i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); animation: scene3d-live-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
.canvas-frame[data-view="3d"] .canvas-corner { border-color: rgba(102,230,224,.24); color: rgba(175,230,239,.85); }
.scene-mode-toggle { color: #81d8ee; border-color: rgba(94,202,230,.32); }
.scene-mode-toggle.active { color: #06131a; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #75ede4, #55afd0); border-color: rgba(117,237,228,.7); box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(75,213,221,.15); }
.scene-mode-toggle:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .38; }
@keyframes scene3d-live-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: .65; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
@media (max-width: 580px) {
  .scene3d-hud { padding: 7px; font-size: 6px; letter-spacing: .06em; gap: 5px; }
  .scene3d-hud span { gap: 4px; }
  .scene3d-hud span:last-child { max-width: 46%; justify-content: flex-end; text-align: right; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .scene3d-hud span:first-child i { animation: none; }
}


/* RELEASE 1.6.0 — premium tactical inspector, camera deck and live threat cues */
.scene3d-controls[hidden], .scene-object-inspector[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.scene3d-controls { position:absolute; z-index:6; top:46px; right:10px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; align-items:flex-end; max-width:calc(100% - 20px); padding:7px; border:1px solid rgba(106,220,230,.24); border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(4,14,22,.9),rgba(4,12,19,.72)); box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.28),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04); backdrop-filter:blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px); }
.canvas-frame[data-view="3d"] .scene3d-controls { display:flex; }
.scene3d-presets,.scene3d-zoom-controls { display:flex; gap:4px; align-items:center; }
.scene3d-control { min-height:29px; padding:6px 9px; border:1px solid rgba(116,190,212,.2); border-radius:4px; background:rgba(8,22,32,.78); color:#c0dce9; cursor:pointer; font:700 8px/1.2 var(--mono,monospace); letter-spacing:.08em; white-space:nowrap; touch-action:manipulation; transition:color .16s ease,background .16s ease,border-color .16s ease,transform .16s ease; }
.scene3d-control:hover { color:#efffff; border-color:rgba(106,233,227,.55); transform:translateY(-1px); }
.scene3d-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset:2px; }
.scene3d-control.active,.scene3d-control[aria-pressed="true"] { color:#041418; background:linear-gradient(120deg,#80f4e7,#60bfd0); border-color:rgba(143,250,238,.72); }
.scene3d-control.scene3d-zoom { min-width:30px; padding-inline:7px; font-size:14px; }
.scene3d-control.scene3d-reset { color:#ffc282; border-color:rgba(255,170,93,.22); }
.scene-object-inspector { display:grid; grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin:0 15px; padding:13px 14px; border:1px solid rgba(95,210,226,.24); border-top:0; background:linear-gradient(112deg,rgba(9,25,35,.97),rgba(5,15,23,.97) 70%,rgba(18,28,38,.96)); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 9px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.13); }
.scene-object-sigil { width:40px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(118,240,231,.26);border-radius:8px;color:#76f0e7;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgba(118,240,231,.14),rgba(3,14,22,.88) 72%);font:22px/1 var(--mono,monospace); }
.scene-object-copy { min-width:0; }
.scene-object-eyebrow,.scene-object-title-row,.scene-object-readout { display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;min-width:0; }
.scene-object-eyebrow { margin-bottom:4px; }
.scene-object-code { color:#5a8196;font:700 7px/1.3 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.09em;white-space:nowrap; }
.scene-object-title-row h3 { margin:0;color:#edfaff;font:800 12px/1.35 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.05em;overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.scene-object-status { flex:0 0 auto;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(125,163,184,.2);border-radius:4px;color:#adc1cf;background:rgba(125,163,184,.055);font:800 7px/1.2 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.05em; }
.scene-object-status[data-state="active"],.scene-object-status[data-state="ready"],.scene-object-status[data-state="warning"] { color:#ffc27f;border-color:rgba(255,180,93,.25);background:rgba(255,155,65,.075); }
.scene-object-status[data-state="success"] { color:#8fe8bd;border-color:rgba(143,232,189,.25);background:rgba(143,232,189,.07); }
.scene-object-status[data-state="danger"] { color:#ff8799;border-color:rgba(255,127,142,.28);background:rgba(255,127,142,.08); }
.scene-object-copy p { margin:5px 0 8px;color:#8ca5b6;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5; }
.scene-object-readout { justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px 16px;color:#587689;font:700 7px/1.45 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.045em; }
.scene-object-actions { display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(104px,auto) 70px 28px;align-items:center;gap:5px; }
.scene-object-actions button { min-height:35px;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(114,190,213,.22);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(9,24,34,.9);color:#a5c2d2;font:800 7px/1.25 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.035em;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation; }
.scene-object-actions button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:rgba(118,240,231,.55);color:#f0ffff; }
.scene-object-actions button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #76f0e7;outline-offset:2px; }
.scene-object-actions button:disabled { opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed; }
.scene-object-actions .scene-object-primary { border-color:rgba(118,240,231,.34);color:#091a20;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#8af2e8,#63cde0); }
.scene-object-actions .scene-object-primary:disabled { color:#86a0ad;border-color:rgba(118,160,181,.16);background:rgba(16,33,44,.86); }
.scene-object-actions .scene-object-dismiss { min-width:28px;width:28px;padding:0;font-size:16px;color:#6f91a5; }
.decoy-action .action-symbol { color:#f0bd75;border-color:rgba(240,189,117,.26);background:rgba(240,189,117,.08); }
.decoy-action:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:rgba(240,189,117,.55);background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(64,45,25,.72),rgba(15,22,28,.9)); }
.decoy-action.targeting,.decoy-action[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color:rgba(255,194,112,.8);background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(92,58,24,.38),rgba(22,25,30,.95));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,194,112,.12),0 0 20px rgba(255,178,79,.09); }
.decoy-action.targeting small { color:#f0c98e; }
.canvas-frame[data-view="3d"] #scene3d-board { touch-action:none; }
@media(max-width:850px) { .scene-object-inspector{grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px;margin:0 8px;padding:11px}.scene-object-sigil{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:19px}.scene-object-actions{grid-column:2;width:100%;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(70px,84px) 34px}.scene-object-actions button{min-height:40px;font-size:8px}.scene-object-actions .scene-object-dismiss{width:34px} }
@media(max-width:480px) { .scene3d-controls{top:35px;right:5px;gap:4px;padding:4px;max-width:calc(100% - 10px)}.scene3d-presets,.scene3d-zoom-controls{gap:3px}.scene3d-control{min-height:27px;padding:5px 6px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.035em}.scene3d-control.scene3d-zoom{min-width:27px;font-size:13px}.scene3d-control.scene3d-reset{font-size:6px}.scene-object-inspector{grid-template-columns:30px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;padding:9px}.scene-object-sigil{width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:6px;font-size:17px}.scene-object-title-row{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.scene-object-title-row h3{font-size:10px}.scene-object-copy p{font-size:10px}.scene-object-readout{font-size:6px;gap:5px 10px}.scene-object-actions{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(65px,76px) 32px}.scene-object-actions button{min-width:0;padding:6px 4px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:0}.decoy-action{min-height:58px} }
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .scene3d-control,.scene-object-actions button { transition:none!important; } }


/* RELEASE 1.7.0 — live mission readouts and cinematic scene grading */
.scene3d-statusbar[hidden] { display:none !important; }
.scene3d-statusbar {
  position:absolute; z-index:5; left:12px; right:12px; bottom:32px;
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:6px;
  pointer-events:none; transform:translateZ(0);
}
.scene3d-status-chip {
  min-width:0; padding:8px 10px 7px; border:1px solid rgba(102,186,210,.17); border-radius:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(5,15,24,.90),rgba(7,19,29,.74));
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035),0 5px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
}
.scene3d-status-chip > span { display:block; margin-bottom:4px; color:#6d8fa3; font:700 7px/1.2 var(--mono,monospace); letter-spacing:.12em; }
.scene3d-status-chip > strong { display:block; overflow:hidden; color:#bbd2de; font:800 9px/1.3 var(--mono,monospace); letter-spacing:.035em; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="warning"] { border-color:rgba(255,181,96,.28); }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="warning"] > strong { color:#ffc07c; }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="alert"] { border-color:rgba(255,127,142,.33); background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(45,13,21,.88),rgba(15,14,23,.8)); }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="alert"] > strong { color:#ff9aa8; }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="ready"] { border-color:rgba(255,198,120,.28); }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="ready"] > strong { color:#ffd29a; }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="success"] { border-color:rgba(105,223,178,.22); }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="success"] > strong { color:#91e9c1; }
.scene3d-status-chip[data-state="neutral"] > strong { color:#b1c8d6; }
@media(max-width:700px) {
  .scene3d-statusbar { left:6px; right:6px; bottom:28px; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:4px; }
  .scene3d-status-chip { padding:6px 8px 5px; border-radius:4px; }
  .scene3d-status-chip > span { font-size:6px; margin-bottom:3px; letter-spacing:.08em; }
  .scene3d-status-chip > strong { font-size:7px; }
}
@media(max-width:380px) {
  .scene3d-statusbar { left:4px; right:4px; bottom:25px; gap:3px; }
  .scene3d-status-chip { padding:5px 6px 4px; }
  .scene3d-status-chip > span { font-size:5px; }
  .scene3d-status-chip > strong { font-size:6px; }
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .scene3d-status-chip { backdrop-filter:none; -webkit-backdrop-filter:none; } }

</style>
<style id="heist-echo-fieldkit-css">

/* HEIST//ECHO 2.0 BLACKSITE DIRECTOR — additive UX layer; does not alter mission rules. */
:root{--he-accent:#f0bd75;--he-cyan:#77e9e6;--he-panel:rgba(10,17,24,.96);--he-line:rgba(150,190,209,.22);--he-text:#edf4f7}

.he-fk-btn{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--he-line);border-radius:7px;color:var(--he-text);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#121e27,#091017);font:600 10px/1.25 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.05em;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s,transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.he-fk-btn:hover{border-color:#f0bd7580;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1c2931,#0c151d);box-shadow:0 5px 18px #0005;transform:translateY(-1px)}.he-fk-btn:active{transform:translateY(0)}.he-fk-btn:focus-visible,.he-fk-dialog button:focus-visible,.he-fk-dialog input:focus-visible,.he-fk-dialog select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--he-cyan);outline-offset:3px}
.he-fk-accent{color:#11161b;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7d7a2,#c9934d);border-color:#f5d6a0}.he-fk-build{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 9px;color:#9bafbc;border:1px solid var(--he-line);border-radius:6px;font:8px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;white-space:nowrap}.he-fk-lamp{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#7fe6b8;box-shadow:0 0 10px #7fe6b8aa}
.he-fk-dialog{width:min(720px,calc(100% - 24px));max-height:min(86dvh,780px);overflow:auto;padding:0;border:1px solid #e0bd7c4d;border-radius:15px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 0 0,#f0bd7510,transparent 42%),linear-gradient(145deg,#101923,#060b10);color:var(--he-text);box-shadow:0 28px 100px #000c;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.he-fk-dialog::backdrop{background:#020507bf;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}.he-fk-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:17px 18px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--he-line);background:#091119f5}.he-fk-eyebrow{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--he-accent);font:8px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.17em}.he-fk-title{margin:0;color:#f1f5f7;font:500 clamp(23px,4vw,32px)/1.06 Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.03em}.he-fk-desc{margin:9px 0 0;color:#a3b2bd;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}.he-fk-close{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none;border:1px solid var(--he-line);border-radius:6px;background:#0c151c;color:#dce7ec;cursor:pointer;font-size:20px}.he-fk-body{padding:16px 18px 19px}.he-fk-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.he-fk-setting{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--he-line);border-radius:8px;background:#09121a}.he-fk-setting strong{display:block;color:#e1ebef;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}.he-fk-setting small{display:block;margin-top:5px;color:#91a4b2;font-size:9px;line-height:1.5}.he-fk-switch{width:38px;height:23px;position:relative;flex:none}.he-fk-switch input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}.he-fk-switch span{position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid #71879555;border-radius:20px;background:#17232c;pointer-events:none;transition:.18s}.he-fk-switch span:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:#a8b7c1;transition:.18s}.he-fk-switch input:checked+span{border-color:#dbb875;background:#886432}.he-fk-switch input:checked+span:before{left:18px;background:#fff0c7}.he-fk-switch input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--he-cyan);outline-offset:3px}
.he-fk-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:13px}.he-fk-section-title{margin:19px 0 8px;color:#88a1b0;font:8px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.15em}.he-fk-command-search{width:100%;min-height:43px;margin-bottom:10px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #8ba8ba44;border-radius:7px;background:#060d13;color:#edf4f7;font:12px system-ui}.he-fk-commands{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.he-fk-command{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;min-height:50px;padding:10px 11px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--he-line);border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#111d27,#091017);color:#e6eef3;cursor:pointer}.he-fk-command:hover{border-color:#f0bd757a}.he-fk-command span{display:block}.he-fk-command strong{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:600}.he-fk-command small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#8da2b0;font-size:9px}.he-fk-command kbd{flex:none;color:#e5c681;font:9px ui-monospace,monospace;border:1px solid #d1b16c45;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 5px}.he-fk-help-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}.he-fk-help-table th,.he-fk-help-table td{padding:9px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--he-line);text-align:left;vertical-align:top}.he-fk-help-table th{color:#91a7b6;font:8px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}.he-fk-help-table td:first-child{white-space:nowrap;color:#f1d49a}.he-fk-footnote{margin:12px 0 0;color:#879ba9;font-size:9px;line-height:1.6}

.he-fk-dock{display:none}.he-fk-health{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:10px 0 0;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--he-line);border-radius:7px;background:#060d13;color:#a7bac7;font:9px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace}.he-fk-health strong{color:#e7d3a5;font-weight:600}.he-fk-health [data-state="error"]{color:#ffb2a8}.he-fk-health [data-state="ok"]{color:#86e6ba}.he-fk-live{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
body.he-fk-focus .cinematic-dossier,body.he-fk-focus .mission-strip,body.he-fk-focus .first-run-guide,body.he-fk-focus .protocol-panel,body.he-fk-focus .footer,body.he-fk-focus .top-meta{display:none!important}body.he-fk-focus .topbar{min-height:50px}body.he-fk-focus #top.shell{padding-top:10px}
body.he-fk-contrast{--he-panel:#05090d;filter:contrast(1.07)}body.he-fk-contrast .panel,body.he-fk-contrast .he-fk-dialog{border-color:#b4d0df90!important}body.he-fk-contrast .field-label,body.he-fk-contrast .eyebrow,body.he-fk-contrast .hint,body.he-fk-contrast small{color:#d4e1e8}
body.he-fk-large{font-size:110%}body.he-fk-large .panel p,body.he-fk-large .status-message,body.he-fk-large .action-button,body.he-fk-large .quiet-button{font-size:1.07em}body.he-fk-compact .panel{padding:12px!important}body.he-fk-compact .intro{margin-bottom:10px!important}body.he-fk-compact .workspace{gap:10px!important}body.he-fk-compact .panel-heading{margin-bottom:7px!important}
body.he-fk-reduced *,body.he-fk-reduced *:before,body.he-fk-reduced *:after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
body.he-fk-hide-ambience .ambient{opacity:0!important}body.he-fk-tap .action-button,body.he-fk-tap .quiet-button,body.he-fk-tap .map-layer-toggle{min-height:42px!important}
.he-fk-export-input{display:none!important}body.he-fk-focus .he-fk-dock{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:740px){.topbar{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.he-fieldkit-actions{gap:5px}.he-fk-btn{min-height:38px;padding:8px;font-size:9px}.he-fk-build{display:none}.he-fk-clock{font-size:9px;padding:7px 8px}.he-fk-grid,.he-fk-commands{grid-template-columns:1fr}.he-fk-head{padding:13px}.he-fk-body{padding:12px}.he-fk-dialog{max-height:calc(100dvh - 18px);margin:auto}.he-fk-dock{position:fixed;z-index:80;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;padding:7px;border:1px solid #b5d4e033;border-radius:11px;background:#060d13ed;box-shadow:0 12px 40px #0009;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}.he-fk-dock .he-fk-btn{min-width:0;min-height:43px;padding:6px 3px;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:0}.he-fk-dock .he-fk-btn span{white-space:nowrap}.he-fk-dock-spacer{height:70px}.he-fk-clock{margin-left:0}}

<style id="he-forge-release-styles">
.he-forge-panel{margin:0 0 23px;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(106,237,230,.28);border-radius:6px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 8% 0,rgba(34,156,160,.12),transparent 47%),linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(13,27,37,.98),rgba(7,13,20,.98));box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(223,255,255,.035),0 18px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.he-forge-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:15px}.he-forge-kicker{margin:0 0 6px;color:#69e7dc;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:800}.he-forge-head h3{margin:0;color:#f0f8fb;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.015em}.he-forge-head p{max-width:680px;margin:7px 0 0;color:#93a9b8;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65}.he-forge-mark{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 44px;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(99,226,220,.35);border-radius:5px;color:#8af4e8;background:rgba(44,175,170,.08);font-size:21px}

.he-forge-toggles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:11px 0 14px}.he-forge-toggle{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;padding:11px;border:1px solid rgba(135,173,193,.17);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(12,26,36,.72);cursor:pointer}.he-forge-toggle input{flex:0 0 auto;accent-color:#61e3d9;margin:2px 0 0}.he-forge-toggle b{display:block;color:#dceaf0;font-size:10px}.he-forge-toggle small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#7f98a9;font-size:9px;line-height:1.5}
.he-forge-buttons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}.he-forge-buttons .he-dir-btn{min-height:40px}.he-forge-note{margin:12px 0 0;color:#7f98a9;font-size:10px;line-height:1.6}.he-forge-code-wrap{margin-top:13px;padding:12px;border:1px solid rgba(102,228,218,.22);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(4,12,17,.67)}.he-forge-code-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:7px;color:#8ca6b6;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em}.he-forge-code{min-height:68px;resize:vertical;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.he-forge-import-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;margin-top:13px}.he-forge-import-input{min-height:39px}.he-forge-library{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:14px}.he-forge-saved{padding:12px;border:1px solid rgba(135,173,193,.16);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(8,19,28,.75);min-width:0}.he-forge-saved[data-active=true]{border-color:rgba(104,231,220,.52);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(18,61,64,.34),rgba(8,19,28,.9))}.he-forge-saved-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}.he-forge-saved-title b{color:#e8f2f6;font-size:11px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.he-forge-saved-title span{color:#69ded5;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.1em}.he-forge-saved p{margin:7px 0 10px;color:#8ea4b3;font-size:9px;line-height:1.55}.he-forge-saved-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.he-forge-saved-actions .he-dir-btn{min-height:30px;padding:0 8px;font-size:8px}.he-forge-empty{padding:14px;border:1px dashed rgba(135,173,193,.2);color:#78909f;border-radius:4px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.6}.he-forge-status{min-height:15px;margin:9px 0 0;color:#71e0d4;font-size:10px}.he-forge-status[data-error=true]{color:#ff9e9e}

<style id="he-architect-release-styles">

1fr;gap:14px}.hef-replay-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));aspect-ratio:12/8;gap:2px}.hef-replay-tile{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#10242e;border:1px solid rgba(150,210,217,.1);border-radius:3px;min-width:0;min-height:0;font-size:clamp(7px,1vw,13px);position:relative}.hef-replay-tile.wall{background:#34424d}.hef-replay-tile.mira{color:#8ec4ff;border-color:#6ca6ed}.hef-replay-tile.kite{color:#8df0d5;border-color:#59c6ad}.hef-replay-tile.guard{color:#ff9aa5;border-color:#d96c7b}.hef-replay-transport{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hef-replay-transport input[type=range]{flex:1;min-width:100px;accent-color:var(--hef-cyan)}.hef-foot{color:#69828f;font-size:10px;line-height:1.55;margin:10px 0 0}.hef-badge{font:700 9px var(--mono,monospace);padding:5px 7px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(120,238,231,.08);color:var(--hef-cyan);border:1px solid var(--hef-line)}
@media(max-width:820px){.hef-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hef-editor-layout,.hef-replay-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hef-grid{max-width:100%;gap:2px}.hef-cell{border-radius:3px}.hef-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.hef-head{align-items:flex-start}.hef-title{font-size:20px}}
@media(max-width:430px){.hef-body{padding:10px}.hef-head{padding:12px}.hef-panel,.hef-editor{padding:10px}.hef-controls{align-items:stretch}.hef-field{min-width:100%;flex-basis:100%}.hef-kpi{padding:7px}.hef-kpi strong{font-size:17px}.hef-release{font-size:8px;padding:6px}.hef-grid{gap:1px}.hef-cell{font-size:9px}.hef-cell .hef-cell-mark{font-size:6px;right:1px;bottom:1px}.hef-btn{padding:9px 10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hef-btn{transition:none}}
